description: Source code for the Delivery Note doctype in ERPNext, including class definition, methods for validation, stock updates, and document creation functions.

classes.name: DeliveryNote
classes.description: Main class representing the Delivery Note document, with methods for validation, stock updates, status updates, and related operations.

methods.name: update_billed_amount_based_on_so
methods.description: Updates billed amounts on delivery note items based on sales order details, distributing billed amounts FIFO.

methods.name: get_list_context
methods.description: Provides context for listing delivery notes on the website, including UI options.

methods.name: get_invoiced_qty_map
methods.description: Returns a mapping of delivery note detail IDs to invoiced quantities.

methods.name: get_returned_qty_map
methods.description: Returns a mapping of delivery note detail IDs to returned quantities for return delivery notes.

methods.name: make_sales_invoice
methods.description: Creates a sales invoice from a delivery note, including handling of partial quantities and returns.

methods.name: make_delivery_trip
methods.description: Creates a delivery trip document from a delivery note, including delivery stops.

methods.name: make_installation_note
methods.description: Creates an installation note from a delivery note, tracking installed quantities.

methods.name: make_packing_slip
methods.description: Generates a packing slip document from a delivery note.

methods.name: make_shipment
methods.description: Creates a shipment document from a delivery note, including contact and address details.

methods.name: update_delivery_note_status
methods.description: Updates the status of a delivery note.

methods.name: make_inter_company_purchase_receipt
methods.description: Creates an inter-company purchase receipt based on a delivery note.

methods.name: make_inter_company_transaction
methods.description: Handles creation of inter-company transactions, either purchase receipt or delivery note, with address and tax updates.
